scanSuppressions.reason: Synthetic sha256 values in validator fixtures exercise Docker cleanup identity; they are not upstream dependency pins.
SCHEMA_VERSION versions Groundwork's internal CI receipt format, not an external dependency.

surfaces.compensatingControl: The base image is tag-and-digest pinned; the disposable Docker proof, required CI, and owner review gate digest updates.
surfaces.note: Renovate owns the Dockerfile frontend and Ubuntu base image, but digest updates do not receive a universal release-age guarantee.

surfaces.compensatingControl: Immutable SHAs and digests, Zizmor, exact-SHA CI, consumer validation, and owner review govern these updates.
surfaces.note: Renovate extracts action SHAs, version comments, runner labels, and workflow containers; pin and digest update types are outside the five-day guarantee. GHCR does not expose releaseTimestamp for Gitleaks tags, so renovate.json disables the age check only for that exact tag-and-digest-pinned dependency.

surfaces.compensatingControl: The preset freeze remains authoritative until the owner approves a released tag and updates this consumer explicitly.
surfaces.note: The unversioned reference is owner-gated/manual because Renovate cannot update it until it is version-pinned.

surfaces.compensatingControl: The updater refreshes four platform checksums atomically and the validator rejects a version/checksum mismatch.
surfaces.note: ShellCheck and shfmt require one bounded repository command rather than an unsafe version-only edit.

surfaces.compensatingControl: Homebrew channel provenance, Groundwork's update transaction, and managed cask checksum policy govern installed releases.
surfaces.note: Homebrew owns installed formula and cask versions; Renovate does not edit the Brewfile.

surfaces.compensatingControl: update-all applies Groundwork's separate five-day mise release-age policy before changing a machine runtime.
surfaces.note: Renovate can extract this well-known mise path, so renovate.json explicitly excludes it and leaves update-all as the sole mutation owner.

surfaces.compensatingControl: The installer and validator enforce the Node/Corepack compatibility boundary before applying the fallback pin.
surfaces.note: Corepack compatibility is reviewed deliberately rather than updated as an isolated version token.

surfaces.compensatingControl: The validator requires the intentional Python 3.12 compatibility pin to remain explicit and compatible.
surfaces.note: Aider's compatibility runtime is a deliberate exception to the general Python channel.

surfaces.compensatingControl: Terminal-interaction review and live tmux verification are required for a plugin release change.
surfaces.note: The Catppuccin tmux release changes only with the surrounding user-interaction contract.

surfaces.compensatingControl: These deliberately valid and invalid workflow snippets exercise policy rejection; they are never executed as repository workflows.
surfaces.note: Workflow syntax fixtures may contain intentionally unpinned references that are test input rather than live dependencies.

surfaces.compensatingControl: Installers use bounded official release discovery, published checksum verification where available, and disposable image proof.
surfaces.note: Headless release assets are not static Renovate edit targets.
